class.name: ThrottlePositionItem
class.brief_description: A single row of the throttle table (DList) for a mechanical-transmission diesel engine.
class.description: Each [ThrottlePositionItem] corresponds to one line of the [code]DList[/code] table. Its index within [member TrainDieselEngine.throttle_table] corresponds to the throttle position, starting from 0.

members.member: [code]DList:C[/code] Clutch and governor behavior at this throttle position.
[code]DList:B[/code] Fuel dose at this throttle position, as a fraction (0..1) of the nominal dose.
[code]DList:A[/code] The throttle position number this row applies to, starting from 0.

constants.constant: No clutch engagement at this position.
Half clutch engagement, at minimum RPM.
Full clutch engagement, at maximum RPM.
Half clutch engagement up to [member TrainDieselEngine.min_rpm], then full clutch.
Two-thirds clutch engagement; RPM interpolated 2/3 min + 1/3 max.
